name: wrsr
title: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic
reminders: Workers & Resources: the game lets only the account named in $OWNER_ID update the item from inside the game; set it to your SteamID64 there if you will also upload from the game.
Workers & Resources: its tags are numbers in the game's own list for each item type; set them in the game's editor or on Steam.
facts: A Workshop item is a folder, media_soviet/workshop_wip/<item number>/, holding workshopconfig.ini, previewimage.png and a folder per object. Checked on five local items and one downloaded item, 23 Nov 2026.

workshopconfig.ini is lines of $KEY value ending with $END, strings in double quotes: $ITEM_ID, $OWNER_ID (the uploader's SteamID64), $ITEM_TYPE, $VISIBILITY, $TAGS (numbers, repeatable), $OBJECT_BUILDING and the like, $ITEM_NAME and $ITEM_DESC.
There is no version field, so the version comes from each mod's catalogue entry.
Public items were seen with $VISIBILITY 2 and with 0, so the game's scale may differ from Steam's; the uploader here sets Steam's visibility itself and leaves the file's alone.
The official modding wiki (wiki.hoodedhorse.com) refused automated reading, so these facts come from files and Steam discussions.
